items.name: Pierina
items.summary: Historic high-sulfidation Au-Ag mine in Ancash, Peru. PyOrex treats Pierina as a deposit knowledge entity rather than a current exploration opportunity.
items.geology: Published USGS work describes mineralization hosted by rhyolitic ash-flow tuffs above andesite-dacite lavas, adjacent to a dacite flow-dome complex.
items.mineralization: USGS studies document advanced-argillic to vuggy-silica alteration and strong lithologic and structural control on hydrothermal fluid flow.
items.history: Barrick states that Pierina began operations in 1998 and that productive activity in the open pit ended in 2013, followed by closure activities.
